metadata.description: Validation test for the GNSS fix rules (docs/fpv-hud-gnss-test-plan.md, T04): hovering while the satellites go 14 → 3 at 8 s → 2 at 14 s → 14 at 20 s. The fix is 3D, then 2D with altitude and vertical velocity held, then none with every output held, and 3D again 1 s after the satellites return.
